20,000,000 Shares

Class A Common Stock

This is an initial public offering of shares of Class A common stock of Northwind Robotics, Inc. Northwind Robotics, Inc. is offering 20,000,000 shares of its Class A common stock.

Prior to this offering, there has been no public market for our Class A common stock. The initial public offering price is $24.00 per share.

Our Class A common stock has been approved for listing on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol “NWRB.” Our Class A common stock is expected to begin trading on the New York Stock Exchange on November 5, 2026.

See the section titled “Risk Factors” beginning on page 14 to read about factors you should consider before buying shares of our Class A common stock.
